Fact.Name: Form 8978 line 14 total additional reporting-year tax
Fact.Description: Line 14 of this Form 8978: line 13 summed across the affected tax-year columns explicitly selected. Inactive columns contribute zero; every active column requires a complete line 13. The signed amount a return reports is /form8978AllFormsLine14Total, which adds the filer's other Forms 8978.

Fact.Name: Form 8978 line 16 total penalties
Fact.Description: Sum the corresponding reported line across the selected applicable years. Inactive columns contribute zero; active columns require a complete amount.

Fact.Name: Form 8978 line 18 total interest
Fact.Description: Sum the corresponding reported line across the selected applicable years. Inactive columns contribute zero; active columns require a complete amount.

Fact.Name: Total of line 14 from the filer's other Forms 8978
Fact.Description: The sum of line 14 of every other Form 8978 the filer files for this reporting year: the separate form for the other source of adjustments (AAR filing or BBA audit), and any additional form for applicable tax years beyond the fourth. Negative for a total decrease. Leave it unanswered when this is the only Form 8978.

Fact.Name: Total increase or decrease to reporting year tax from all Forms 8978
Fact.Description: Line 14 of this Form 8978 (zero when no applicable year is selected) plus the stated total of line 14 from the filer's other Forms 8978 (zero when unanswered). This signed total is the amount the instructions report on the appropriate line of the return: a positive total is additional tax, a negative total a decrease.

Fact.Name: A Form 8978 line 14 amount is entered on this return
Fact.Description: True when this Form 8978 has one or more applicable years selected, or the line 14 total of the filer's other Forms 8978 is answered. When true, the amount the return reports from Form 8978 is /form8978AllFormsLine14Total: its positive part is Form 1040 line 16 tax (taxCalculations /otherFormForm8978Tax) and its negative part, as a positive number, is line 2 of the Schedule 3 line 6l worksheet (schedule3 /sched3Line6lWorksheetLine2NegativeForm8978Amount). False on a return that enters no Form 8978.

Fact.Name: This Form 8978 marks both sources of adjustments, or neither
Fact.Description: Refuses a return whose Form 8978 has an applicable year selected and answers the two source-of-adjustments boxes the same way, both BBA Audit and AAR Filing, or neither. Adjustments from an AAR filing and from a BBA audit are reported on separate Forms 8978, each with one box checked; the other form's line 14 goes in the other-forms total. The filer corrects it by checking the one box that matches this form.

Fact.Name: Return files Form 8978
Fact.Description: True when one or more applicable tax-year columns are included on the Form 8978.
